snippet.title: One Last Sacrifice - Closed Beta Trailer | March 13
snippet.description:
One Last Sacrifice is a PvP autobattler where every decision counts. Draft your units, build powerful synergies, and outplay your opponents in fast-paced strategic combat.

Closed Beta starts March 2026.
Secure your spot and sign up now: https://one-last-sacrifice.com
